The Universal Knowledge Router

The premise is simple: any source the user throws at the system should be translated into clean markdown so agents can read it later. A URL becomes an article. A PDF becomes prose. A binary becomes an asset reference.

Why markdown

Every modern model reads markdown natively. It is the lingua franca of agent memory. Binary formats burn context windows for nothing.

For longer documents the router preserves the original on disk so the user never loses fidelity.
